# OpenFX headers (vendored, unchanged)

[OpenFX](https://openfx.readthedocs.io), release 1.5 (OFX_Release_1.5, commit a98b77b), the C headers of the image effect plugin API
(`include/*.h`; the documentation sources, images and the OCIO test file are not copied). Licence: BSD-3-Clause (LICENSE.md,
GPL-compatible), Academy Software Foundation. Used by `src/ofx/` (the OpenFX host, spec 158) and the test plugin in `tests/ofx/`.
The HostSupport library of the OpenFX project is not used: Kinoklip has its own host.
